assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original synthetic photographic banner for the authenticated main page of Cybersecurity Incident Registry. Create an ultra-wide 3:1 landscape composition, designed for a very shallow web header. Show CONCRETE CYBERSECURITY EQUIPMENT at close range: the recognisable front panels of enterprise servers and a network switch, realistic RJ45/fibre ports with short neatly connected cyan cables, metal ventilation grids, and a physical flat security-console monitor on the RIGHT. On the monitor show a believable compact security-event interface: horizontal rows of authentication events, one red highlighted unauthorised-access event, and a rectangular red outbound-data-transfer alert beside a small database/table icon. The screen is a fictional decorative prop, not an exact chart or real sensitive data. Optional tiny labels only 'ACCESS ALERT' and 'DATA TRANSFER'; no other readable identifiers. The physical equipment and console must dominate; this must instantly read as a cybersecurity incident in a server environment, not a starfield or abstract network. Composition: very tight eye-level product/editorial photography. Keep the main switch ports, central server bays, monitor bezel and red alert within the central horizontal third of the canvas so these physical elements survive a 10:1 center banner crop. Concentrate useful visual action in the RIGHT two-thirds, leave the LEFT third calm matte midnight navy for separately typeset application title. The server geometry is rectilinear and close; the alert is restrained and professional. Palette deep navy, black brushed metal, natural cool cyan equipment light, one small red warning area. Crisp realistic textures, convincing reflected light, photographic optical depth, restrained enterprise aesthetic, no excessive glow. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, hands, faces, silhouettes or reflections. NO star-like points, constellations, connected nodes, network graphs, globe, dots-and-lines, abstract floating particles, waveforms in empty space, holograms, hooded hackers, padlocks, shield icons, giant warning triangles, administrative papers, folders, logos or watermark. Do not create the website interface or title, only the photographic hero asset. Original fictional facility and event. Preserve a wide low horizontal composition rather than a tall monitor portrait.
